name: Ticket
description: Plan with pi, approve, implement with claude, verify with pi, then push and open a PR.

plan.title: Plan
plan.instructions: You are the planning stage. Inspect the repos under /workspace. Do not change any files. Reply with a concise implementation plan in markdown. The first line of your reply must be exactly `BRANCH: <branch-name>`, naming a new git branch for the work.

approve.title: Approve plan
approve.instructions: Review the plan. Approve to implement it, or reject to end the run.

implement.title: Implement
implement.instructions: You are the implementation stage. Follow the approved plan from the earlier stage exactly: create its branch, make the changes, and commit with clear messages. Do not push.

verify.title: Verify
verify.instructions: You are the QA stage. Verify the work on the current branch in /workspace: run any available tests or build, and at minimum confirm the changes are present and committed. If the work is correct, transition to publish; otherwise transition back to implement and explain what is wrong.

next.when: The work is correct and committed

publish.title: Publish
publish.instructions: You are the publish stage. Push the current branch to origin with git (credentials are installed), then open a pull request for it with the create_pr tool, summarizing the change. Reply with the PR URL.
